{"code": "df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep only the row with highest sample_seq per patient
# Sort by sample_seq descending, then drop duplicates on patient_id
df_dedup = df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Now check the number of patients in treatment arm
n_treatment = df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment'].shape[0]
n_responded_treatment = df_dedup[(df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment') & (df_dedup['responded'] == 1)].shape[0]

fraction_responded = n_responded_treatment / n_treatment

print(f"Deduplicated rows: {len(df_dedup)}")
print(f"Patients in treatment arm: {n_treatment}")
print(f"Responded in treatment arm: {n_responded_treatment}")
print(f"Fraction responded: {fraction_responded:.4f}")"}
